0022600024.text: The Denver Nuggets (2-2) are in their fifth game of the season, coming off a win and sitting 4th in the Northwest, 2 games back and 8th in the West, while the Phoenix Suns (1-2) have lost their last game and are 3rd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back and 11th in the West. Denver is without Alpha Diallo (personal), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain, day-to-day and a game-time decision). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 125-123 win in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
